Package de.hallerweb.enterprise.prioritize.ui

Class MainLayout

java.lang.Object
com.vaadin.flow.component.Component
com.vaadin.flow.component.applayout.AppLayout
de.hallerweb.enterprise.prioritize.ui.MainLayout
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.vaadin.flow.component.AttachNotifier, com.vaadin.flow.component.DetachNotifier, com.vaadin.flow.component.HasElement, com.vaadin.flow.component.HasStyle, com.vaadin.flow.router.RouterLayout, Serializable
@Layout @PermitAll public class MainLayout extends com.vaadin.flow.component.applayout.AppLayout
Application shell for the admin GUI: a title bar with a logout button and a navigation drawer. Annotated with Layout, so Vaadin automatically wraps every route that does not opt out (via autoLayout = false, as LoginView does) into this layout. Individual views therefore only render their own content; the frame (navigation, current user, logout) lives here and is shown on every authenticated page.

Current user and logout are taken from Vaadin's AuthenticationContext rather than the static security context, mirroring DashboardView.

Author:
peter haller
